comment: Guest-internal network plan for the remote provider Arch/KVM acceptance (#263). Every address lives on a dummy interface INSIDE the disposable guest, which has no route out (QEMU user networking with restrict=on). The expected_policy values are checked against providerd's production address policy by a Rust unit test (src/providerd/src/remote/tests.rs) and against the operator's DNS classifier by scripts/test-remote-provider-kvm-harness.py.

unit_os_policy.comment: What the unit's IPAddressDeny=localhost link-local multicast must block at the OS level (EPERM). Private, CGNAT, ULA and public destinations are NOT blocked by the unit: only providerd's application policy refuses them.
